name: Datadog CVE: COMMIT + DROP SCHEMA
sql: SELECT 1; COMMIT; DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE;

name: UPDATE in readonly
sql: UPDATE users SET name = 'hacked' WHERE id = 1

name: ALTER TABLE in readonly
sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN hacked boolean

name: Comment-based (safe — DROP is inside a SQL comment, harmless)
Legitimate SELECT (should pass)
sql: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE id = 1

name: SELECT with JOIN (should pass)
sql: SELECT u.name, o.total FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id

name: SELECT with subquery (should pass)
sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total > 100)

name: SELECT with string containing semicolon (should pass)
sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE bio = 'hello; world'
